name: Fix: silent try/catch swallowing in test masks real failures
task: The 'Complete purchase flow' test always passes even when steps fail — errors are silently swallowed by try/catch blocks. Fix it so failures are properly reported.
passCriteria: Identifies the try/catch shouldContinue pattern as the root cause
Removes all try/catch wrappers from the test steps
Replaces shouldContinue guard blocks with direct await calls
Test steps now propagate errors naturally to Playwright's test runner
failCriteria: Adds more error handling instead of removing existing try/catch
Only removes some try/catch blocks but not all
Does not address the root cause (shouldContinue guard blocks remain)
